gloss: to call oneself, to give one's name, to claim to be

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {名乗|なの}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to give one's name, to introduce oneself
definitions.explanation: To state one's own name or identity when meeting someone or in an official context.

definitions.gloss: to call oneself, to claim to be, to go by the name of
definitions.explanation: To adopt or use a particular name, title, or identity. Can imply the claim may or may not be legitimate.

notes:
The compound ⟦{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る→名乗り出る：21784_nanorideru⟧ (to come forward, to volunteer, to step forward) is very common and has two uses: coming forward to identify oneself (to police, authorities) or volunteering for something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る→名乗り出る：21784_nanorideru⟧ — to come forward, to volunteer
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{名乗|なの}る — to give one's name
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{名乗|なの}る — to call oneself ~, to go by ~
- ⟦{名乗|なの}り→名乗り：10661_nanori⟧ — self-introduction (noun form)
